effects.does: Opens the Clara assistance interface.
effects.affects: nothing.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that the Clara interface opens.

effects.does: Changes the ranking view to rank vendors on each lot.
effects.affects: the event's bid comparison or ranking mode.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that vendor rankings are shown by lot.

effects.does: Opens the available buy-template selection.
effects.affects: the template used to define the event fields and configuration.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that buy templates are displayed.

effects.does: Opens controls for adding columns to the sheet.
effects.affects: the event's line-item fields and captured bid data.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that column options are shown.

effects.does: Opens a file picker or upload flow for importing a sheet.
effects.affects: the event's line items and their column values when the upload succeeds.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that a sheet-upload flow opens.

effects.does: Opens the event details configuration.
effects.affects: event-level details such as title or description when they are saved.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that event details can be viewed or edited.

effects.does: Opens the price-components configuration.
effects.affects: the price fields or component breakdown used for vendor bids.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that price-component settings are shown.

effects.does: Opens the vendor invitation flow.
effects.affects: the event audience by adding selected vendors.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that vendors can be searched and invited.

effects.does: Opens the event participants view.
effects.affects: nothing unless participants are added or removed there.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that the current participants are listed.

effects.does: Opens the event savings configuration or view.
effects.affects: the event's savings data used during creation or evaluation.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that savings settings or values are displayed.

effects.does: Opens the terms and conditions editor.
effects.affects: the event's payment or other terms configuration.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that terms and conditions can be entered or edited.

effects.does: Opens the schedule editor for the event's start and end time.
effects.affects: the stage schedule and its closing time or duration.
effects.check: Click the control and verify that the current Now start, end time, and duration can be edited.

effects.does: Opens the publish confirmation flow for the event.
effects.affects: the event by validating and, after confirmation, publishing or saving it.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that a confirmation dialog with publish controls appears.

effects.does: Navigates to the Events list.
effects.affects: nothing.
effects.check: Click the link and verify that the Events list opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of this event
effects.does: Sets the title of the event.
effects.affects: the event title submitted in the event record and validated at publish.
effects.check: Enter text and verify that it remains in the title field and is included in validation.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Searches for and selects vendors to add to the event.
effects.affects: the event audience and participant records.
effects.leadsTo: stays here with selected vendors shown.
effects.check: Search for an eligible vendor, select it, and verify that it appears as a participant.

effects.does: Sets or displays the product for a line item.
effects.affects: the line item's product record and the product-dependent event data.
effects.leadsTo: product selector or stays here after selection.
effects.check: Select a product and verify that the line item stores the selected product.

effects.does: Sets or displays the product variant for a line item.
effects.affects: the line item's product-quality or variant record.
effects.leadsTo: variant selector or stays here after selection.
effects.check: Select a variant and verify that the line item stores the selected variant.

effects.does: Sets the quantity requested for the line item.
effects.affects: the line item's requested quantity and the quantity available for award or ordering.
effects.check: Enter a quantity and verify that the value is retained for the line item.

effects.does: Sets the delivery location for the line item.
effects.affects: the line item's delivery-location data used for fulfillment.
effects.leadsTo: location selector or stays here after entry.
effects.check: Enter or select a location and verify that it is retained on the row.

effects.does: Sets the base price for the line item.
effects.affects: the line item's bid price and price-based totals or ranking.
effects.check: Enter a price and verify that the row stores the value using the displayed currency.

effects.does: Sets the quantity available for the line item.
effects.affects: the quantity vendors can offer and later award or order quantities.
effects.check: Enter an available quantity and verify that the row stores it separately from requested quantity.

effects.does: Sets the GST value or tax information for the line item.
effects.affects: the line item's tax data and potentially its calculated total amount.
effects.check: Enter a GST value and verify that the row retains the tax information.

effects.does: Displays or calculates the line item's total amount.
effects.affects: the row's amount used for comparison and the event's financial totals.
effects.check: Change the relevant quantity or price and verify that the total amount recalculates.
